Subject: Vendor delegation inventory + proposed DPA language

Hi Soojin / Kimberly / Jordan,

Thanks for the call yesterday. As discussed, CloudNexus needs to be added as an authorized subprocessor for the Order Form tied to RWI-1147. Attaching our delegation inventory CSV and a short summary of the data flows we expect to touch.

Quick ask: please confirm whether Redwood will accept our standard DPA excerpt (attached) as an annex to the Order Form, or whether you need an MSA amendment + signature. We can fast-track either, but want to align on the minimal path that meets your legal and procurement controls.

We can provide SOC 2 Type II and a data flow diagram by Friday (2026-11-27).

Attachments: vendor-delegation-inventory.csv

Cheers,
Anna Morales

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-23T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor delegation inventory + proposed DPA language

Thanks Anna — looping in Legal and Sales to confirm approach.

Kimberly / Markus: quick context — CloudNexus will be processing request/response payloads for our embeddings pipeline under the Order Form for RWI-1147. They propose to accept their standard DPA excerpt as an annex. Procurement prefers an Order Form amendment rather than altering the MSA if possible, but Legal to confirm.

What we need from Legal to advise:
- Can the DPA excerpt be accepted as an annex to the Order Form (no MSA change)?
- If not, what redline language is required for the Order Form amendment?
- Required evidence (SOC2, penetration test, data flow diagram) to satisfy compliance gate and expected delivery dates.

Jordan — if Legal is okay with annex approach, can you prepare an Order Form amendment template (1 page) we can send to Anna? Target: get signatures by 2026-12-03.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Head of Strategic Procurement | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor delegation inventory + proposed DPA language

Soojin — thanks for the context. Summary from Legal below.

1) Annex approach: acceptable in principle.
   - If CloudNexus signs an annex that explicitly references the Order Form and incorporates the MSA security and data processing obligations, we do not need to amend the MSA.
   - Annex must include: scope of processing, subprocessor list, data retention boundaries, incident notification timeline (<=72 hours), and a clause allowing Redwood to audit/evidence-check critical controls.

2) Required evidence:
   - SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12 months) OR an attestation from their auditor if the full report contains redactions.
   - Data flow diagram showing where Customer PII or model input data is stored, processed, and transmitted (simple swimlane-style).
   - Pen test summary (last 12 months) or vulnerability management attestation.

3) Redlines: Legal will provide a short annex template (one page) that references the Order Form ID and has the clauses above. Please request CloudNexus to sign the annex and return with evidence. If their DPA excerpt lacks any of the required items, we'll propose the annex instead.

I've attached the evidence checklist and a DPA excerpt we use for reference.

Attachments: evidence-checklist.pdf, dpa-excerpt.docx

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
